description: Use to edit a bucket list: the price bar, months or date window, nights, stops, airlines, preferred weekdays, name, guests, stars, or channels, and a flight list's filters (airlines left out, connecting airports, times, duration, layovers, emissions, bags). Only the fields given change; a filter given replaces the stored one, and clear_filters names the ones to remove. A changed search resets the deals found so far. Confirm first.

airlines.description: Only these marketing carriers, as IATA codes or names.
airlines.title: Airlines

arrive_after.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.
arrive_after.title: Arrive After

arrive_before.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.
arrive_before.title: Arrive Before

carry_on_bags.description: Carry-on bags per traveler (0-1). Prices then include the bag fees: search_flights shows them as price_with_bags next to the fare; a calendar or bucket list prices every day with them.
carry_on_bags.title: Carry On Bags

check_in_days.description: Hotel lists: only check in on these weekdays.
check_in_days.title: Check In Days

checked_bags.description: Checked bags per traveler (0-2), priced only for flights within the US and Canada (elsewhere the answer says the prices do not include them). Prices then include the bag fees: search_flights shows them as price_with_bags next to the fare; a calendar or bucket list prices every day with them.
checked_bags.title: Checked Bags

clear_window.description: Remove the date window and watch the months instead.
clear_window.title: Clear Window

connecting_airports.description: Only itineraries that change planes at these airports (codes or city codes), nonstops included: for 'US connections only' name the hubs.
connecting_airports.title: Connecting Airports

depart_after.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.
depart_after.title: Depart After

depart_before.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.
depart_before.title: Depart Before

depart_days.description: Flight lists: only depart on these weekdays.
depart_days.title: Depart Days

email.description: Send alerts by email. Empty keeps the account's setting.
email.title: Email

exclude_airlines.description: Leave out itineraries with any flight sold by these carriers (IATA codes, names or an alliance), by flight number or airline name: for 'not Gol' or 'avoid Air India'.
exclude_airlines.title: Exclude Airlines

exclude_connecting_airports.description: Leave out itineraries that change planes at these airports (codes or city codes).
exclude_connecting_airports.title: Exclude Connecting Airports

lower_emissions.description: Only itineraries with lower emissions than is typical for the route.
lower_emissions.title: Lower Emissions

max_duration_hours.description: Longest itinerary to show, in hours.
max_duration_hours.title: Max Duration Hours

max_layover_hours.description: Longest layover allowed at every connection, in hours (half hours allowed): for 'layovers no longer than 5 hours'.
max_layover_hours.title: Max Layover Hours

max_nights.description: Flight lists: longest trip. Hotel lists: the stay length.
max_nights.title: Max Nights

max_price_usd.description: The price bar, USD: per traveler for a flight list (total when price_is_total), per night for a hotel list.
max_price_usd.title: Max Price Usd

max_stops.description: Most stops allowed: 0 nonstop, 1, or 2 (2 or more: any number).
max_stops.title: Max Stops

min_layover_hours.description: Shortest layover allowed at every connection, in hours (half hours allowed): for 'at least 2 hours to connect'.
min_layover_hours.title: Min Layover Hours

min_nights.description: Flight lists: shortest trip. Hotel lists: the stay length.
min_nights.title: Min Nights

months.description: Months to watch, as names or YYYY-MM. Give this OR start_date + end_date.
months.title: Months

name.description: A new label for the list.
name.title: Name

price_is_total.description: Flight lists: max_price_usd is the total for all travelers.
price_is_total.title: Price Is Total

return_days.description: Flight lists: only return on these weekdays.
return_days.title: Return Days

text.description: Send alerts by text message. Needs a verified phone on the SlickTrip account; empty keeps the account's setting.
text.title: Text

name: update_bucket_list

changed.description: Fields sent to the update handler, site vocabulary (price, stops, preferredMonths, ...)

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

display_name.description: Name as the card shows it

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

route.description: Flight only: origin, destination, names, trip_type, cabin, travelers

stay.description: Hotel only: location, hotel_name, nights, adults

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

title: Update a bucket list
